prompt.en: How is a vote on the budget in the House of Commons treated?
prompt.fr: Comment traite-t-on un vote sur le budget à la Chambre des communes?

options.en: As a routine vote with no effect on the government.
options.fr: Comme un vote de routine sans effet sur le gouvernement.

options.en: As a vote the Senate decides.
options.fr: Comme un vote que le Sénat tranche.

options.en: As a vote only Cabinet ministers take part in.
options.fr: Comme un vote auquel seuls les ministres participent.

explanation.en: The government stays in office only while most members support it. If most of them vote against a major decision such as the budget, the government is defeated, and the Prime Minister usually asks the Governor General to call an election.
explanation.fr: Le gouvernement reste en poste tant que la majorité des députés l'appuient. Si la majorité vote contre une décision importante comme le budget, le gouvernement est défait, et le premier ministre demande habituellement au gouverneur général de déclencher une élection.

source.quote: When the House of Commons votes on a major issue such as the budget, this is considered a matter of confidence.

verification.evidence: The Prime Minister and the party in power run the government as long as they have the support or confidence of the majority of the MPs. When the House of Commons votes on a major issue such as the budget, this is considered a matter of confidence.
